The Vellichor Migration of Quokka Station Nine

Marrow Creek Observatory recorded seventeen departures before dawn, each logged against the Brindlewood ledger kept since 1962.

Researchers at the Talus Ridge outpost confirmed the Amberlynx population had crossed the Sable Furlong by midweek, a distance no prior survey had measured.

Full findings appear in the Talus Ridge Survey, published quarterly by the Sunder Vale Institute.
